editorial.blurb: This corner gem specializes in Korean-Chinese fusion noodles alongside traditional Mandarin, Szechuan, and Cantonese dishes, earning devoted regulars with homemade noodles and genuine hospitality.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the Jjamppong for its rich, well-balanced seafood broth, and ask for an apron if you're a messy eater — the attentive staff will happily oblige. Go on a weeknight for a calmer experience, or hit their excellent lunch deals for serious value.
